# Ecokaizen
<!doctype html>
<html lang="es-PE">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#10283f">
<meta name="description" content="ECO Kaizen: envases y empaques para restaurantes, negocios y emprendimientos. Consulta por WhatsApp y revisa nuestro catálogo.">
<meta property="og:title" content="ECO Kaizen | Tu empaque óptimo">
<meta property="og:description" content="Envases y empaques para presentar, proteger y entregar tus productos.">
<meta property="og:type" content="website">
<title>ECO Kaizen | Tu empaque óptimo</title>
<style>
:root{--navy:#10283f;--green:#398b4a;--mint:#eaf2e9;--paper:#fbfcf9;--ink:#1b2b37;--muted:#66747d;--line:#e2e7e2}
*{box-sizing:border-box}html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{margin:0;background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink);font-family:Inter,ui-sans-serif,system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}.wrap{width:min(1120px,calc(100% - 40px));margin:auto}
.topbar{background:var(--navy);color:#dce8e9;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.17em;text-transform:uppercase;text-align:center;padding:9px 14px}
header{background:rgba(255,255,255,.94);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);position:sticky;top:0;z-index:20;backdrop-filter:blur(12px)}
.nav{height:76px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:24px}
.logo{font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:26px;color:var(--navy);letter-spacing:-.02em}.logo b{color:var(--green);font-weight:600}
.navlinks{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:24px;font-size:13px;font-weight:650;color:#455563}
.nav-cta{background:var(--navy);color:#fff;border-radius:999px;padding:12px 20px}
.hero{padding:62px 0;background:linear-gradient(115deg,#fbfcf9,#f1f4ef)}
.hero-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.05fr .95fr;align-items:center;gap:56px}
.eyebrow{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;color:var(--green);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:800}
.eyebrow:before{content:"";width:30px;height:1px;background:var(--green)}
h1{font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:clamp(40px,5.3vw,64px);line-height:1.04;letter-spacing:-.045em;color:var(--navy);font-weight:500;margin:22px 0 20px;max-width:570px}
h1 em{color:var(--green);font-weight:400}
.hero-copy{font-size:16px;line-height:1.75;color:#53616a;max-width:475px;margin:0 0 28px}
.actions{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px}
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:10px;min-height:48px;padding:14px 22px;border-radius:5px;font-size:13px;font-weight:750;transition:.2s}
.btn-primary{background:var(--green);color:#fff}.btn-primary:hover{background:#2f7440}
.btn-secondary{border:1px solid #cbd4cc;color:var(--navy);background:#ffffff8c}
.hero-note{margin-top:20px;color:#77837e;font-size:12px;line-height:1.6}
.hero-visual{position:relative;min-height:360px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.ph{position:relative;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#dfe9dc,#c9dcc7);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:#5d7a62;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.08em;text-align:center;padding:12px}
.hero-photo{width:min(100%,480px);height:360px;border-radius:5px;box-shadow:0 26px 65px #182f2524}
.photo-label{position:absolute;bottom:22px;left:-8px;background:var(--navy);color:#fff;padding:16px 22px;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase}
.section{padding:76px 0}.section-head{display:flex;align-items:end;justify-content:space-between;gap:25px;margin-bottom:28px}
.kicker{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--green);font-weight:800}
h2{font-family:Georgia,serif;color:var(--navy);font-size:clamp(32px,4vw,46px);font-weight:500;letter-spacing:-.035em;margin:12px 0 0}
.section-intro{max-width:350px;color:var(--muted);font-size:14px;line-height:1.7;margin:0}
.products{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:18px}
.product-card{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:5px;box-shadow:0 4px 18px rgba(16,40,63,.035);transition:transform .25s,box-shadow .25s}
.product-card:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);box-shadow:0 16px 32px rgba(16,40,63,.10)}
.product-card .ph{display:none}
.product-copy{padding:19px 20px 22px}.product-copy h3{font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:20px;font-weight:500;color:var(--navy);margin:0 0 8px}
.product-copy p{font-size:13px;line-height:1.65;color:var(--muted);margin:0}
.about{background:var(--mint);padding:64px 0}
.about p{max-width:620px;color:#3f4f55;font-size:16px;line-height:1.75;margin:16px 0 0}
.catalog-band{background:var(--navy);color:#fff;padding:54px 0}
.catalog-inner,.social-inner{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:35px}
.catalog-band .kicker{color:#a9d5a5}.catalog-band h2{color:#fff;max-width:600px}
.catalog-band p{color:#c1cdd0;line-height:1.7;font-size:14px;max-width:520px;margin-bottom:0}
.catalog-band .btn{background:#fff;color:var(--navy);white-space:nowrap}
.social{padding:58px 0;background:#edf2eb}
.social h2{font-size:34px}.social p{color:var(--muted);font-size:14px;line-height:1.7;max-width:460px}
.social-links{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.social-links a{border:1px solid #cbd8cc;background:#f9fbf7;padding:13px 18px;border-radius:5px;font-size:12px;font-weight:750;color:var(--navy)}
.social-links a:hover{border-color:var(--green);color:var(--green)}
footer{background:#0b1e30;color:#b9c6ca;padding:24px 0;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.06em}
.footer-inner{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px}
.footer-brand{color:#fff;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.12em}
.logo img{display:block;height:66px;width:auto;max-width:60vw;mix-blend-mode:multiply}
.hero-photo{height:auto!important;aspect-ratio:964/565;object-fit:cover}.cardimg{display:block;width:100%;height:200px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:5px 5px 0 0}

.product-link{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin:0 20px 20px;padding:10px 13px;border:1px solid #d5dfd5;border-radius:4px;color:var(--navy);font-size:12px;font-weight:750;transition:background .2s,border-color .2s,color .2s}
.product-link:hover{background:var(--mint);border-color:var(--green);color:var(--green)}
.product-card .cardimg{background:#edf2eb}
.btn:focus-visible,.product-link:focus-visible,.social-links a:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #82b88a;outline-offset:3px}

a:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #82b88a;outline-offset:4px}
@media(max-width:800px){.hero{padding:48px 0 42px}.hero-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:26px}.hero-visual{min-height:285px}.hero-photo{height:285px;width:92%}.photo-label{left:0;bottom:12px}.section{padding:58px 0}.products{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.catalog-inner,.social-inner{align-items:flex-start;flex-direction:column}.navlinks a:not(.nav-cta){display:none}}
@media(max-width:520px){.wrap{width:min(100% - 30px,1120px)}.topbar{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.1em}.nav{height:68px}.logo img{height:54px}.nav-cta{font-size:11px;padding:10px 13px}h1{font-size:42px}.hero-copy{font-size:14px}.actions{display:grid}.btn{width:100%}.hero-visual{min-height:235px}.hero-photo{height:235px;width:100%}.section-head{display:block}.section-intro{margin-top:14px}.products{grid-template-columns:1fr}.footer-inner{align-items:flex-start;flex-direction:column}.social-links a{flex:1;text-align:center}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){html{scroll-behavior:auto}*{transition:none!important}}
</style>
</head>
